Genuine dashboard and prompt-injection browser screenshots were captured and embedded in both HTML deliverables. Full print/presentation checks and successful live-model use remain unverified. Two additional extraction attempts after updating DAC100/.env also failed without an upstream HTTP response. Two further browser extraction requests also failed with URLError in the restricted runtime. Python TLS certificate verification was repaired; DAC100 authentication was then changed to Authorization: Bearer to match the course examples. The rolling 20-request cap has been reached before this change could be verified. One supervised diagnostic extraction using the Bearer header returned HTTP 403 in the Codex runtime; its persistent 20-request cap was not changed.
